regions.merged_text: I found Sister Mary Rosella noted on August 9th: so have made out her certificate accordingly and am herewith inclosing. I hope it will be satis- factory - glad you called my attention. Please pardon oversight and consequent delay. I can easily understand something of how you feel, hustling all day in the hospital, etc. It's a great work in itself and a wonderful opportunity to prac- tice charity and of course mortification in so many ways, which brings one nearer to God and endears to the Sacred Heart. Naturally "social life" often suffers - and what is to be regretted in many cases - family life too. This latter is realy important and in every way should be supplied as far as possible. . Prayer in your and O. J.'s case, I trust has helped - and let us hope will help more than anything else under circumstances.
